claims.statement: Winfree 1967 Journal Theoretical Biology 16(1):15–42 on coupled biological oscillators preceded Kuramoto 1975
claims.locator: Publisher DOI and bibliographic metadata; antecedent not exclusive invention claim

claims.statement: Yoshiki Kuramoto 1975 Self-entrainment published Lecture Notes in Physics vol 39 pp420–422
claims.locator: Springer DOI and Japanese scholarly index; modern symbol notation not asserted original

claims.statement: Classical all-to-all phase-coupling Kuramoto equation dtheta_i/dt = omega_i+(K/N) sum_j sin(theta_j-theta_i)
claims.locator: Historical model expressed in modern standard notation; ignores amplitude/noise/delay

claims.statement: For symmetric 2-oscillator coupling K/2 each, delta'=DeltaOmega-Ksin(delta), stable locking for |DeltaOmega|<K; DeltaOmega .6,K .8 gives phase ~48.590 degrees
claims.locator: Author-created two-body reduction, trigonometry independently computed; equals case critical

claims.statement: r exp(i psi)=N^-1 sum exp(i theta); three phases 0,120,240 degrees yield r zero despite fixed phase differences
claims.locator: Author-created vector-sum example; order parameter limited to first harmonic

claims.statement: Under all-to-all infinite symmetric unimodal distribution g centered zero, classical Kc=2/(pi g(0)); Lorentzian halfwidth Delta gives Kc=2Delta
claims.locator: Standard Kuramoto thermodynamic smooth symmetric unimodal assumptions; not a generic network formula

claims.statement: Network Kuramoto equations can use unnormalized Aij coupling or degree-normalized strength; these yield noncomparable K
claims.locator: Explicit notation convention and normalization caveat

claims.statement: Restrepo Ott Hunt PRE71 036151 published March30 2005 links synchronization onset under appropriate assumptions to largest adjacency eigenvalue
claims.locator: APS publisher abstract; not a universal exact threshold for all oscillatory networks
